updates.title: Daily change report
updates.detail: Mintmark now publishes a daily report of new, removed, halted, and changed tokenized-stock identities across Ondo, bStocks, and xStocks on BNB Chain.

updates.title: Checked Binance Spot routes
updates.detail: bStocks records show a Binance Spot route only when a stored check found the exact pair trading. Records with a PancakeSwap pool now show both routes.
